recognize_zh: GMS 銀染色低倍：綠色背景的壞死區邊緣聚集大量被染成黑色的圓形微生物，分佈成帶狀，提示肉芽腫中的真菌感染。
features: Numerous black-to-gray silver-positive organisms concentrated in a band at the necrotic interface
Scattered individual black-staining round forms in adjacent necrosis
Individual organism morphology not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power Grocott methenamine silver (GMS) stain of the splenic granulomatous lesion shows a green-counterstained necrotic background with a dense band of silver-positive organisms at the necrotic interface and scattered positive forms in the adjacent necrosis. Detailed morphology of the organisms (budding, size, hyphae) cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings indicate numerous fungal organisms within necrotizing granulomatous inflammation; higher-power evaluation and culture are needed for speciation.

ddx.vs: Mycobacteria are not highlighted as large black forms on GMS and require acid-fast (Ziehl-Neelsen/Fite) staining.
Artifact deposits are irregular and granular without the uniform round or oval shapes of yeast.
